schema

Show machine-discoverable workflow schema and relation rules.

Usage:
  agent-issues schema
  agent-issues schema --json

Options:
  --db <path> | Use a specific SQLite database path.
  --json | Print machine-readable JSON. Entity mutations return acknowledgements; list and relation reads return summaries.
  --pretty | Pretty-print JSON when used with --json.
  --help, -h | Show help for the whole CLI or the selected command.

Examples:
  agent-issues schema
  agent-issues schema --json

Notes:
  Use this command to discover entity kinds, status flows, allowed relations, structural relations, and archive mappings.

Output:
  Human-readable:
    Entity kinds section
    Relation types line
    Structural relation types line
    Allowed relations section
    Structural parent rules section
  JSON fields:
    entityKinds
    relationTypes
    allowedRelations
    structuralRelationTypes
    parentRules
